stem: Kavya starts at point P facing North. She walks 5 m, then turns right and walks 7 m, then turns right and walks 3 m, then turns right and walks 7 m. In which direction is Kavya now facing?

per_option_rationale.rationale: North, right = East, right = South, right = West. Three right turns from North give West as the final facing direction.
Treats the last right turn as a left turn: from South a left turn gives East, not West.
Reports the direction from P to the final point instead of the facing direction. Net position is 2 m North of P, so the student reports North.
Stops the route after the third leg and reads the current facing direction as South, ignoring the fourth turn.

explanation: Track facing direction at each turn. Start: North. Turn right = East (walk 7 m). Turn right = South (walk 3 m). Turn right = West (walk 7 m). Final facing: West. Net displacement check: 5 N - 3 S = 2 m North, 7 E - 7 W = 0. The final point is 2 m due North of P, which is a different quantity from the facing direction.

explanation_sections.punchline: Lock the first right turn: North + right = East. That is the cracking move - it anchors the chain. Two more right turns give South then West. Final facing: West.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply each right turn in sequence, writing the new heading before reading the next clue. Start: North. Right turn 1: East (walk 7 m, direction unchanged). Right turn 2: South (walk 3 m, direction unchanged). Right turn 3: West (walk 7 m, direction unchanged). Final facing: West. Verify: three right turns = 270 degrees clockwise = same as one left turn from North = West. Confirm. Note: the question asks for facing direction, not the direction from P to the final point - those are different quantities.
explanation_sections.lesson: Three right turns (270 degrees CW) equal one left turn (90 degrees CCW). Use this shortcut to sanity-check a three-right-turn chain. Distance walked never affects facing direction.
explanation_sections.timing: About 60 seconds. Writing three headings takes under 20 seconds. The trap is option 3 (North) - it confuses the direction from start point P to Kavya's final position (2 m North) with the facing direction. Always answer what was asked.
